subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) We are living in modern society i. and quarrels always i. after receiving a little education (b) The primitive people who occurred gradually (c) They were hostile to each other ii. they would be able ii. as there was no education in (d) But with the passage of time iii. which is really primitive society (e) If the people in modern society iv. were uncivilized and iii. an uncomfortable life in the caves receive true education uneducated led iv. to serve society in many ways v. they began to be v. the contribution of education civilized
guide_solution: (a) We are living in modern society which is really the contribution of education. (b) The primitive people who were uncivilized and uneducated led an uncomfortable life in the caves. (c) They were hostile to each other and quarrels always occurred as there was no education in primitive society. (d) But with the passage of time they began to be civilized after receiving a little education gradually. (e) If the people in modern society receive true education they would be able to serve society in many ways.
